status: prospective specification written before learner runs; not an external preregistration
question: Does learned vector representation add compositional transfer beyond reusable discrete token routing, with identical exact arithmetic?

authorship.U: User proposed examining routed handfilled spiral-language network and authorized this study
authorship.F: Fable authored the unchanged word-level arithmetic core
authorship.A: ChatGPT Pro designed and ran these controls

supervision: Both target primitive IDs for every training command; no answer-only or natural-language learning claim

heldout_splits.lexical: 16 training commands, one of four alias pairs for every primitive pair: alias0=q%2, alias1=p%2; remaining 48 of64 old-vocabulary commands held out
heldout_splits.composition_connected: 48 training commands cover all four alias pairs for12 primitive pairs; hold out the16 commands whose primitive pair satisfies q=(p+1)%4. Each primitive sees three distinct counterpart primitives in both slots.
heldout_splits.composition_diagonal_stress: 16 training commands containing repeated identical primitive operations, all four alias pairs per primitive;48 different-primitive commands held out. Diagnostic only: slot meanings are underdetermined for the joint learner; copying one slot into both can fit training.

model_selection: No test-based selection, restarts, seed exclusion or tuning. Fixed final step; milestones diagnostic only.
growth_stage: Append four new input embedding rows/alias entries, teach four self-paired commands. Compare all-parameter fine-tune against new-rows-only with shared decoder and all old rows frozen. Reset optimizer for both. No output-class growth.
metrics: all 256 x/y answers on common precomputed W outputs
common_executor: Original Fable W candidate word-level profile, two Python-dispatched steps, same y. Frozen for every arm. Not canonical151 or end-to-end raw-bit neural control.
core_cache: Execute all 16 programs on 256 operand pairs once in W, verify against independent Python operators, reuse the resulting4096 outputs for router answer metrics. Counts of reused predictions are not extra W executions.
long_width_check: Separate core check at32/64/128bits, not semantic-router training or arbitrary-length program test
invalid_inferences: Atomic table versus embeddings alone cannot identify a vector advantage
Equivalent programs may share correct answers
Unseen opaque aliases have no inferable meaning without evidence
Freezing old input rows plus fixed output decoder preserves old routes by construction
No claim of natural-language understanding or autonomous architecture growth
